name: France Bed Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: France Bed Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, provides medical services in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Medical Services Business, and Home Furnishing and Health Business. It engages in the manufacturing, procurement, rental, and retail/wholesale sale of medical and nursing care beds, as well as welfare equipment; supply of linen to medical and welfare facilities, as well as hotels; and provision of facility solutions for medical and welfare facilities. The company is also involved in the design of mattresses; operation of showrooms for product experience and sleep consultation; and supply of beds, mattresses, and related products to hotels, inns, and other lodging…
